renderpass.name: Image

renderpass.code:
int N = 26; // NxN particles
#define R    iResolution.xy
#define T(u) texelFetch( iChannel0, ivec2(u), 0 )
#define P(i) T(vec2(i%N,i/N))
renderpass.name: Common

renderpass.code:
#define H   fract(1e4*sin((iTime+float(p))*R))

void mainImage( out vec4 O, vec2 u )
{
    O*=0.; if ( int(u.y) == N )                                  // --- stats
        if (int(u)<1) for(int i; i < N*N; i++) O[int(P(i).z)]++; // compute
        else          O =  T(vec2(u.x-1.,N));                    //  scroll
    
    if ( int(u) >= N || int(u.y) >= N ) return;                  // simulates NxN particles
    int p = int(u) + N*int(u.y);                                 // particle id
    O = P(p);                                                    // load previous state
 
    float d = 9., l, v;                                          // --- manage particles
    for( int i; i < N*N; i++ )                                   // search closest particle
        if ( i != p )
            l = length( O.xy - P(i).xy ),                        // distance
            l < d ? v = P(i).z, d = l : d;                       // keep closest, v = type
        
    d < .04                                                      // if collision
        && mod(O.z-v,3.)==2. ? O.z = v : v;                      // && loose fight, takes other type            

    O.xy = mod(O.xy + (H-.5)/R.y *iTimeDelta*90. , R/R.y);       // random displacement
       
    if (iFrame<1)                                                // --- init: random location and type
        O.xy = H*R/R.y, O.z = floor(mod(O.x*R.x,3.));            // type = 0:rock 1:paper 2:scissor
}
